Lemma
[Behavior of $\mu (g,\tau )$ for $\tau $ small] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0402 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants 1. appD:D.42\group Perelman Invariants

For every closed Riemannian manifold there is $\bar\tau >0$ such that $\mu (g,\tau )<0$ for $0<\tau <\bar\tau $, and $\lim _{\tau \downarrow 0}\mu (g,\tau )=0$.
